message.content:
Based on my search, here is the login information for PreLicenseTraining:

## Student Login

To access your student account, go to the main login page:
- **URL:** https://prelicensetraining.com/login

You'll need to enter your **login name** and **password**. (Tip: Your login name may be your email address unless you specified otherwise during registration.)

## Mentor/Recruiter/Company Login

If you are a mentor, recruiter, or company representative, use one of these portals depending on your specific platform:

- **PSI Online Mentor Login:** https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login
- **Infinity Schools Mentor Login:** https://infinityschools.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login
- **General Mentor Login:** https://prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login

## Forgot Your Password?

- **Students:** Password recovery is available through the main login page
- **Mentors (PSI Online):** https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/forgotPassword

## New User?

If you don't have an account yet, you can register at: https://prelicensetraining.com/register

---

**About PreLicenseTraining.com:** They provide online insurance pre-licensing and continuing education training with streaming video instruction, online textbooks, practice exams, and a virtual testing center called StudyHall. They have helped over 150,000 individuals obtain their insurance licenses.
